app TypedTemporalArrays
Given
 Slot { count:int=1, at:datetime=datetime("2030-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"), counts:int[], instants:datetime[], seedCounts:int[]=[1,2], seedInstants:datetime[]=[datetime("2030-01-01T00:00:00.000Z")], maybeCounts:int[]?, maybeInstants:datetime[]?, requiredCounts:int[]! }
 policy Slot read=public
When
 crud Slot by=members fields=count,at,counts,instants,seedCounts,seedInstants,maybeCounts,maybeInstants,requiredCounts
 ## Both admitted arrays and stored arrays participate in native typed operations.
 scenario advance(slot:Slot,delta:int,at:datetime,counts:int[],instants:datetime[],accept:bool) -> datetime by=members
  do
   require at>slot.at and at>slot.created
   require all(instants as instant,instant>slot.at)
   require all(slot.seedInstants as instant,instant>slot.created)
   set slot {count=slot.count+delta+sum(counts)+sum(slot.seedCounts),at=at+1s,counts=counts,instants=instants}
   require accept
   return slot.at
 scenario numbers(slot:Slot) -> int[] by=members
  do
   return [sum(slot.counts),slot.count]
 scenario times(slot:Slot) -> datetime[] by=members
  do
   require all(slot.instants as instant,instant>slot.created)
   return slot.instants
 scenario maybeNumbers(slot:Slot) -> int[]? by=members
  do
   return slot.maybeCounts
 scenario maybeTimes(slot:Slot) -> datetime[]? by=members
  do
   return slot.maybeInstants
 scenario created(slot:Slot) -> datetime by=members
  do
   return slot.created
 ## Null is a value; an ordinary omitted array remains empty.
 scenario echoMaybeNumbers(value:int[]?) -> int[]? by=members
  do return value
 scenario echoMaybeTime(value:datetime?) -> datetime? by=members
  do return value
 scenario total(values:int[]) -> int by=members
  do return sum(values)
 scenario namedDefault(__proto__:datetime=datetime("2030-01-01T00:00:00.000Z")) -> datetime by=members
  do return __proto__
 scenario born() -> datetime by=members
  do
   create Slot {requiredCounts=[]} as slot
   require sum(slot.seedCounts)==3
   return slot.at
 ## Original parameter defaults remain wire receipt data while handlers see native values.
 scenario defaults(value:int=2,counts:int[]=[1,2],at:datetime=datetime("2030-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"),instants:datetime[]=[datetime("2030-01-01T00:00:00.000Z")]) -> datetime by=members
  do
   require value+sum(counts)==5
   require all(instants as instant,instant>=at)
   return at+1s
Then
